title: GE Aerospace: Full Throttle - [Business Breakdowns, EP.235]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down GE Aerospace.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down GE Aerospace. We did cover GE several years ago, but that episode focused on Larry Culp's turnaround of the conglomerate. Ramesh Narayanaswamy, co-founder and portfolio manager of Tourbillon Partners, joins me to explore what is now a pure-play aerospace business.

key_points.text: We discuss the unique dynamics of the aerospace supply chain and the long-cycle nature that differentiates this industry.
We also explore the complexity of aircraft engine manufacturing and how GE exemplifies the powerful model of selling services attached to equipment.
Please enjoy our conversation on GE Aerospace.
